instruction: Flip the inverted video to its proper position and save it with the name '1984_Mac_Ad.mp4' on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 6: Count files matching the pattern '1984_Mac_Ad.mp4' on Desktop and verify at least one exists, confirming the rotated video was saved successfully.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete verification coverage: Instruction requires TWO steps (1) flip/rotate the video and (2) save as '1984_Mac_Ad.mp4', but evaluator only checks step 2 (filename existence)

Critical semantic gap: Evaluator cannot verify the main task requirement (video rotation/flipping). Only checks if a file with the target name exists, not whether the video content was actually transformed
False positive vulnerability: User could simply rename the original flipped video to '1984_Mac_Ad.mp4' without rotating it, and evaluator would pass incorrectly
Missing state verification: No verification of video properties, metadata, or orientation to confirm the flip operation was performed
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add getter to extract video rotation metadata (e.g., using ffprobe to read video rotation matrix or orientation flags)
Add metric to compare video orientation before/after or verify rotation metadata indicates proper orientation (0 degrees rotation)
Alternative: Add getter to extract video dimensions and verify they changed if rotation was 90/270 degrees
Consider adding verification that checks video frame properties to confirm transformation occurred, not just filename change
